name: Senpai Daisuki!!
source:
The birthday started out like usual. The only difference this time is that I was invited by my honored teacher's daughter. 

That was the day she went from being my teacher's daughter... to my lover. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061364.html]DLsite English[/url]]
